'''Armadylean guards''' are [[aviansie (race)|aviansie]] that appear and attack the player when doing [[coordinate]] steps of [[elite clue scroll]]s. They call out {{overhead|No warning! Be gone!}} upon appearing.

The guard will spawn upon digging at the correct coordinates, and must be defeated in order to advance in the [[Treasure Trail]]. Like the [[aviansie]] found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]], the guard is flying too high to be attacked using most [[melee]] weapons, and must instead be defeated by means of [[ranged]], [[magic]], a [[salamander]], or a [[halberd]]. Since the guard only uses ranged attacks, [[Protect from Missiles]] will prevent all damage.

After defeating the guard, the player must dig at the same spot again, and will be allowed to do so unhindered.

On clue scroll steps where the Armadylean guard can appear, alternatively a [[Bandosian guard]] may appear in its place. The lone exception is [[Clue_scroll_(elite)_-_08.30S_10.48W|this clue]] on the [[Isle of Souls|Isle of Souls]], where an Armadylean guard will always appear.

Despite being an [[aviansie]], killing an Armadylean guard will not count towards the clue step "Kill an [[aviansie]]."

==Trivia==
* There is currently a glitch where the guard's death cry is heard twice. The second cry happens when the drop appears, as the drop seems to have a small delay.
* Despite being an [[aviansie]], killing an Armadylean guard does not count toward an aviansie Slayer task.
